comment: This is a plain static site — no framework, no build step, no server. Everything runs in the visitor's browser. These three fields stop Vercel from auto-detecting a framework and then failing because it cannot find one.

headers.comment: COOP+COEP make the page cross-origin isolated, which is what unlocks SharedArrayBuffer and therefore MULTITHREADED ffmpeg.wasm. Without these two headers the app still works, but ffmpeg falls back to the single-threaded core and video jobs run several times slower.
The ffmpeg engine is content-addressed by version in its URL, so it can be cached forever.
App code is small; revalidate so deploys take effect immediately.
